title: Enhanced irradiation-resistance in NbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy via rhenium addition.

recollection.structure: Guess: refined grain structure or altered phase composition
recollection.mechanism: Guess: improved irradiation resistance due to increased lattice strain or altered defect dynamics
recollection.results: Guess: enhanced resistance to irradiation-induced damage, possibly measured by changes in hardness, swelling, or defect density

score.note: The recollection identifies Re addition and broadly suggests grain refinement, lattice strain, and altered defect dynamics, but these are generic guesses lacking the paper-specific amorphous grain-boundary regions, defect-sink behavior, and suppression of grain-boundary He bubbles. It gives no irradiation conditions or numerical mechanical results; the stated enhanced resistance largely repeats the title.
